new_value: Implemented Rust PUT /config support in ConfigClient with ConfigUpdate/NodeRole public APIs. Portable name/role fields are typed and role-enumerated; radio/identity links are read-only; extension fields are preserved. Client emits canonical string-keyed application/cbor matching lci_config.json, validates server mutation bounds/tags/duplicates atomically before transport, and requires exact 2.04 Changed while surfacing 4.xx and unexpected 2.xx responses. Added canonical-vector, validation, limit, UDP method/path/content-format/payload, unauthorized, and unexpected-success tests. Green: cargo test -p lichen-client --features tokio --locked (91 unit + 16 integration); clippy --lib -D warnings; no-default-features lib check; cargo fmt --check.
